row.notes: myteam-g2: Builds a vector (out, allocator sponsors+0x210) of pointers to sponsor records from the global 0x160-byte sponsor list (sponsors+0x520..0x528) for the given team: skips sponsors whose id (+0x28) the team already holds in its own list (team record +0x18..+0x20, team records 0x88 stride at +0x298) and only takes those with +0x110 == 0. Used to build offer cards in the corporate setup and sponsor contracts view.

verify.notes: V9652 Builds vector of sponsor pointers from global list (+0x520..), but when the team already has the sponsor it pushes the team own record (0x160 stride) instead of skipping it, and others only if +0x110==0.
